Leave the heavy curved stone ribs that form the pointed opening intact, including its narrow innermost rim. The resulting opening is uninterrupted cloudy sky right up to the pointed apex. Preserve the exact source composition, framing, border positions, arch geometry, columns, side statues, stone texture, sky and lighting outside the tracery area. This will be composited back into the full painting. Keep all edges and the four sides of the input registered in the output, same aspect ratio and crop. No labels, new objects, or new sources of light.
